If you’re a parent navigating the NYC school maze in 2024, you’ve probably heard the whispers at the playground by Travers Park or in the bodega near 74th St–Broadway: “Gifted & Talented.” These programs, sprinkled across Manhattan, Queens (think PS 122 in Astoria, a stone’s throw from the N/W at Astoria Blvd), Brooklyn, and even Staten Island, promise a more challenging academic environment than typical public schools. Office hours at DOE Family Welcome Centers (e.g., 28-11 Queens Plaza North, open Mon-Fri, 8am-3pm) can involve waits of up to an hour, especially around application deadlines. Applying for Gifted & Talented in NYC isn’t just a paperwork shuffle—you’ll need sharp timing, insider know-how, and a MetroCard with a minimum balance to zigzag between boroughs like Queens and Manhattan. If you’re juggling shifts in Jackson Heights or Elmhurst, remember: the application portal works 24/7, but the Family Welcome Centers (like 28-11 Queens Plaza North, right off the E/M/R at Queens Plaza) are only open weekdays, 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. results.title: Family Welcome Centers
results.content:
# Family Welcome Centers (FWCs)

FWCs support families enrolling in NYC Public Schools with specific enrollment needs. Parents and guardians can schedule a virtual or in-person appointment at any location to get help with school enrollment. FWCs are open Monday - Thursday from 8am - 5pm, and Friday from 8am - 3pm.

Illustration of dad and daughter at a desk talking to enrollment

## Services

Family Welcome Centers provide specific services. If your child has a zoned school or received an offer from a school through the admissions process, you need to contact that school directly for enrollment help. Family Welcome Centers can offer specific enrollment services which are listed below. [...] ### NYC Schools Account (NYCSA)

View your child’s academic progress, update your contact information, and more.

### Parent University

Parent University seeks to educate and empower families through free courses, resources, events, and activities.

### MySchools

Apply to grades 3-K –12, explore and compare schools, and more.

## Enrollment

## Learning

## School Life

## Connect with NYCPS

NYC Public Schools logo

Copyright ©  New York City Department of Education. [...] Enrollment Forms

Our office cannot make changes to the application or waitlist process. If you would like to explore other school options, you must add your child to the waitlists of other desired schools through your MySchools account.

MySchools

New and returning elementary or middle school students do not need to visit our office. You can find your zoned school using our Find a School tool, and enroll directly at the school.

Find a School

If you cannot find an appointment that works for you, please call 718-935-2828 for assistance in finding a date and time that work for you.
